= Configure Appium AI for your organization
:description: Turn Appium AI on or off and set a default LLM provider for every Appium session in your organization.

// DRAFT (KOB-53282): Generated by Robot Ranch for docs-team review. Do not publish until the open questions in the PR are resolved.

Organization settings let you turn Appium AI on or off and set a default LLM provider for your organization in Kobiton. Appium sessions started by members of your organization use these settings without any changes to `dc.ini` on each host.

Use organization settings to:

- Provide your LLM provider details to Kobiton once, instead of in every test script.
- Avoid entering LLM provider credentials in `dc.ini` when Kobiton hosts your devices.
- Turn Appium AI off for your organization from a single place.

Appium AI is not available for Public Cloud devices.

== Configure organization settings

// The Portal UI is tracked separately and its labels are not confirmed in the source evidence.

. Open the Appium AI organization settings in Kobiton. _[Placeholder: navigation path pending confirmation.]_
. Turn Appium AI on or off for your organization.
. Optional: Enter your LLM provider settings.
. Save your changes.

New Appium sessions use the saved settings.

The LLM provider settings are optional. If you turn Appium AI on without entering a provider, pass the provider settings in each Appium session with `kobiton:*` capabilities. See xref:appium-ai/override-llm.adoc[Override Appium AI settings per session].

== Available settings

Organization settings include the following. Each setting can be overridden for a single session with the listed capability.

[cols="3,3", options="header"]
|===
| Setting | Session capability

| Appium AI on or off
| None

| LLM provider base URL
| `kobiton:llmBaseUrl`

| LLM provider API key
| `kobiton:llmApiKey`

| API format
| `kobiton:llmApiFormat`

| API version
| `kobiton:llmApiVersion`

| Text model
| `kobiton:llmTextModel`

| Vision model
| `kobiton:llmVisionModel`

| Text model extra request body
| `kobiton:llmTextExtraBody`

| Vision model extra request body
| `kobiton:llmVisionExtraBody`

| Locator strategy
| `kobiton:locatorStrategy`
|===

== How Appium AI chooses a setting

For each setting, Appium AI uses the first value it finds in this order:

. A capability passed in the Appium session.
. Your organization settings.
. The `dc.ini` file on the host running the session.
. The Kobiton default.

`dc.ini` remains supported. It sets defaults for a host and is the only way to configure hosts that are not connected to your organization in Kobiton.

=== Turning Appium AI on or off

Appium AI runs on a host only when both of the following are on:

- Appium AI in your organization settings
- `LlmClient.Enabled` in `dc.ini` on that host

If you turn Appium AI off in your organization settings, Appium AI is off for your organization's sessions on every host. If `LlmClient.Enabled` is off in `dc.ini`, Appium AI stays off on that host even when your organization setting is on.

If your organization has never saved Appium AI settings, `dc.ini` alone controls Appium AI. Existing `dc.ini` configurations continue to work.

=== API keys and base URLs

An API key applies only to the base URL set at the same level or a lower level. A key from `dc.ini` is never sent to a base URL set in your organization settings or in a session.

If you pass `kobiton:llmBaseUrl` in a session, also pass `kobiton:llmApiKey` in that session.
